title: Correct motion (NoRMCorre)
description: Runs NoRMCorre on the stack, when it is on the MATLAB path: rigid with gridSize 0, piecewise rigid otherwise. Saves the aligned stack and the shifts of each frame (frames x 2, subpixel).

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

output.title: Aligned stack
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

shiftsOutput.title: Shifts
shiftsOutput.description: Variable the shifts are saved to. Leave empty to not save it.
